content.description:
About Gokaldas Exports
Gokaldas Exports Limited is one of India's leading apparel manufacturers and exporters, with a strong global presence and an established legacy in the garment manufacturing industry. With a diverse workforce and a commitment to operational excellence, innovation and sustainable growth, GEX continues to strengthen its people capabilities to support its evolving business priorities.At GEX, we believe our people are central to our success. We are committed to building a future-ready organisation through leadership development, talent excellence, continuous learning and a strong organisational culture.
Role Overview
The role will be responsible for supporting and driving Talent Management and Organisation Development initiatives across the organisation. This includes leadership development, succession planning, talent reviews, performance management, organisational effectiveness, culture-building and change management.The position will work closely with business leaders and HR stakeholders to strengthen leadership capabilities, build a robust talent pipeline and implement structured people interventions aligned with the organisation's strategic objectives.The ideal candidate should bring a combination of strategic thinking, programme management capabilities, strong execution discipline and a people-centric approach to designing and implementing talent initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
1. Talent Management & Succession PlanningSupport the implementation of talent management frameworks, tools and interventions aligned with organisational priorities.Coordinate talent reviews, succession planning processes and leadership pipeline initiatives.Facilitate the identification and development of high-potential employees and critical talent.Support career development, talent mobility and leadership readiness initiatives.2. Leadership DevelopmentDesign, coordinate and execute leadership development initiatives across organisational levels.Partner with business leaders to identify leadership capability gaps and development priorities.Coordinate leadership assessments, development programmes and coaching interventions.Monitor programme effectiveness and track leadership development outcomes.3. Performance Management System (PMS)Support the administration and continuous improvement of the Performance Management System.Coordinate performance cycles, goal-setting, mid-year reviews and annual appraisals.Ensure timely completion of performance processes and provide necessary support to employees and managers.Analyse performance outcomes and support talent and development decisions.4. Organisation Development & EffectivenessSupport organisation development interventions, including organisational effectiveness, change management and transformation initiatives.Partner with business and HR teams to strengthen team effectiveness and organisational capabilities.Contribute to organisation design, role clarity and competency framework initiatives as required.Support interventions aimed at improving organisational productivity and effectiveness.5. Culture & Employee EngagementContribute to culture-building initiatives that reinforce organisational values and desired behaviours.Support employee engagement interventions and initiatives to strengthen employee experience.Facilitate initiatives that promote collaboration, accountability and a high-performance culture.6. Programme Management & AnalyticsCoordinate and track the annual Talent Management and OD calendar, ensuring timely execution of key initiatives.Analyse talent data, prepare dashboards, reports and insights to support management decisions.Manage external consultants, assessment partners, learning vendors and programme logistics.Ensure effective programme governance, stakeholder communication and process discipline.Apply design-thinking principles to create employee-centric, structured and scalable talent processes.
Candidate Profile3–5 years of relevant experience in Talent Management, Organisation Development, Learning & Development or related HR functions.Hands-on experience in coordinating and implementing initiatives across leadership development, talent management, succession planning, PMS, OD, culture and employee engagement.Strong understanding of talent review frameworks, leadership development methodologies and performance management processes.Experience in managing organisation-wide HR programmes and partnering with senior business stakeholders.Strong programme management, stakeholder management and execution capabilities.Ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously with a high degree of ownership and attention to detail.Strong analytical skills with experience in talent dashboards, HR reporting and data-driven decision-making.Excellent communication, facilitation, presentation and influencing skills.A balanced approach combining structured processes, creative thinking and a human-centric mindset.
Education & Certifications
Postgraduate degree/diploma in Human Resources, Organisation Development, Organisational Psychology or a related discipline.Certifications in Organisation Development, Change Management, Talent Management or Executive Coaching will be an added advantage.Preferred certifications include:ODCP – Organisation Development Certified Professional.Postgraduate Diploma in Organisation Development & Change Management.Recognised certifications in Talent Management, Change Management or Coaching.
What Makes This Opportunity Exciting?
Opportunity to contribute to organisation-wide talent and leadership initiatives.Exposure to senior leadership and cross-functional business stakeholders.Opportunity to shape talent practices and strengthen organisational capabilities.Be part of a growing global apparel manufacturing organisation with a strong legacy and people-centric approach.
Build talent. Develop leaders. Shape the future with Gokaldas Exports.

COMPETENCIES•Fabric Technical Knowledge•Quality & Compliance•Problem Solving (Root Cause)•Cross-functional Coordination

content.description:
Company Overview

Gokaldas Exports Ltd is a leading manufacturer and exporter of apparel, serving some of the worlds most prominent fashion brands and retailers. With a robust manufacturing footprint and a commitment to operational excellence, the company integrates complex supply chain processes with large-scale production capabilities. Headquartered in Bangalore, Gokaldas Exports leverages advanced technology and data-driven systems to maintain its competitive edge in the global textile and garment industry.

Role Overview

As an Oracle Developer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining critical database applications that power our manufacturing and supply chain operations. You will work closely with cross-functional IT teams and business stakeholders to translate complex requirements into efficient technical solutions. This role is pivotal in ensuring the stability, performance, and scalability of our Oracle-based systems, directly impacting our ability to manage production workflows and business intelligence effectively.

Key Responsibilities

 Develop and optimize complex PL/SQL packages, procedures, and triggers to support core business applications and data integrity. Design and maintain Oracle Forms and Reports to provide actionable insights and user-friendly interfaces for internal departments. Collaborate with functional teams to troubleshoot performance bottlenecks and implement tuning strategies within the Oracle database environment. Manage the end-to-end development lifecycle, from gathering technical specifications to deployment and post-implementation support. Ensure high availability and security of database objects by adhering to best practices in coding standards and documentation. Integrate Oracle-based modules with existing enterprise systems to streamline data flow across the organization.

Required Skillset

 Proven expertise in Oracle PL/SQL, with a strong ability to write complex queries and manage database objects effectively. Hands-on experience in building and maintaining Oracle Forms and Reports for enterprise-level applications. Demonstrated ability to perform database tuning and optimization to improve system responsiveness. Strong analytical skills to interpret business requirements and translate them into robust technical architectures. Excellent communication skills to facilitate collaboration between technical teams and non-technical business stakeholders. A minimum of 6 to 9 years of professional experience in Oracle development environments. Ability to work effectively in an on-site environment in Bangalore, demonstrating adaptability to shifting project priorities.
